items.label: Rebuild MTGCardBelcher image pool
items.description: On r/MTGCardBelcher, rebuild the image pool from the newest 1,000 posts. Elsewhere, reload it from r/MTGCardBelcher.

items.label: Create MTGCardBelcher collector counters
items.description: Post a counter comment for each collectible under this post, and log their ids for the counter settings.

dreadmawCounterCommentId.label: Id of the comment holding Colossal Dreadmaw's collector number (leave unset to disable the art)

stormCrowCounterCommentId.label: Id of the comment holding Storm Crow's collector number (leave unset to disable the art)

negateCounterCommentId.label: Id of the comment holding Negate's collector number (leave unset to disable the art)

curationDryRun.label: Curation dry run: log the flair changes curation would make on r/MTGCardBelcher, and make none

sourceSubreddit.label: Testing only: a subreddit to use as the image source in place of r/MTGCardBelcher. Leave unset, or set to MTGCardBelcher, for normal use.
